title: Public 40-venue previews and environmental component gates
summary: The public 3e11dfb release passes all-40 original-venue driving and multiplayer lobby preview checks, alongside bounded public weather and persistent fog lifecycle gates. Earlier particle checks remain tied to their verified 9089529 deployment checkpoint.
details: Main CI run 38496520618 passed for 3e11dfb7fc0dc598a249da0f371e3890af356a96. Public HTTPS hash checks on furyremastered.com and the Workers origin matched that commit, 517 hosted objects and 47 authored static files; the public log contained 217 entries and 167 screenshots. The separate approved R2 package validated 518 objects, uploaded four changes and totaled 423,236,483 bytes.

On public 3e11dfb, the all-40 drive gate loaded and drove every original venue with full-sample terrain following the ATV, collision and minimap coverage, and no JavaScript/WebGL errors. The lobby gate synchronized selected names and artwork for host and guest in desktop and 390×844 portrait layouts: 39 original preview pairs plus the authored Training capture.

In the separate public Training regression on ebae7427955ec1c85e659a98641ef49664412744 (PR63 checkpoint), the source start remained grounded after 180 idle steps and reset; 390 px touch movement produced 5 ft displacement; four of six hay approaches had wheel support and all six had body contact; the extended boundary remained active beyond 3768.

On the same public 3e11dfb deployment, seven rain lifecycle cases passed. Four isolated Freeport fog cases covered ATV and motorcycle in desktop and portrait Chromium views: 200 persistent source sprites, one draw, 286,192 GPU bytes, with pause/resume, vehicle reset and context restoration preserving state and no page/GL errors. The inspected portrait screenshot uses an explicit source-test placement beside the original fog volume. Earlier public component checks on 9089529 covered ENV07 smoke at its natural source start, FREE06 grill and ENV05 fountain at source-derived test starts, and MC27 Caribou Race Snow; those checks are retained as that release checkpoint, not relabeled as the 3e11dfb test run.

The desktop and portrait public preview captures show Sausalito's original stadium course image in the multiplayer lobby; the final fog portrait shows the ATV, ship and railing through the Freeport fog. Both are automated Chromium captures; the portrait size does not imply a physical-phone test.
limitation: The user has reported mobile water artifacts and blank stadium screens; these are under investigation. The verified routes and component gates do not establish complete visual, physics, or original PS2 hardware parity. Global RNG/order, ScreenRain droplets, some source manager callbacks, moving locomotive smoke, and other lighting/rendering gaps remain.
caption: Public Chromium portrait at 390×844, using an explicit source-test start beside the original Freeport fog: the rider, ship and railing remain visible through the fog. Automated browser capture, not a physical phone.
